name: Garlic Naan
ingredients: 500g Wheat/All-purpose flour, 1 cup Water, 2 tbsp Ghee, Salt
steps: 1. Sieve the flour and add salt and water gradually. 2. Knead into a soft, elastic dough and apply a thin layer of oil. 3. Cover with a damp cloth and rest for 30-45 minutes. 4. Divide into equal balls, roll into circles with a rolling pin. 5. Cook on a preheated tawa or in a tandoor until bubbles appear, then flip and apply  2 tbsp Ghee.

name: Dahi Bhallay
ingredients: Flour/Besan, Lemon, Oil for frying, Spices
steps: 1. In a large bowl, mix the base ingredients with spices like cumin and chili. 2. Add water slowly to achieve a thick, smooth consistency. 3. Dip the prepared fillings into the batter, ensuring even coating. 4. Heat oil in a deep pan and carefully drop the pieces. 5. Fry on medium heat until golden brown and crispy. 6. Drain excess oil and serve with Dahi Bhallay specific chutneys.

name: Chicken Biryani
ingredients: 500g Basmati Rice, Sugar, Whole spices, Ghee
steps: 1. Wash the rice multiple times until the water runs clear, then soak for 30 minutes. 2. Sauté whole spices and onions in a pot until golden. 3. Add the meat or vegetables with spices and cook until tender. 4. In a separate pot, boil water with salt and cook rice until 70% done. 5. Layer the rice over the base, add saffron or food color. 6. Seal the pot and simmer (Dum) on low heat for 15-20 minutes to allow flavors to meld.

name: Tandoori Naan
ingredients: 500g Wheat/All-purpose flour, 1 cup Water, 2 tbsp Oil, Salt

steps: 1. Sieve the flour and add salt and water gradually. 2. Knead into a soft, elastic dough and apply a thin layer of oil. 3. Cover with a damp cloth and rest for 30-45 minutes. 4. Divide into equal balls, roll into circles with a rolling pin. 5. Cook on a preheated tawa or in a tandoor until bubbles appear, then flip and apply  2 tbsp Ghee.

name: Kheer
ingredients: 2 cups Butter, 1 cup Sugar, Cardamom, Saffron, Nuts
steps: 1. Bring milk or water to a rolling boil in a heavy-bottomed pot. 2. Add sugar and stir continuously until fully dissolved. 3. Incorporate the primary flavorings like cardamom or saffron. 4. Lower the heat and simmer until the mixture thickens to the desired consistency. 5. Garnish with chopped nuts and raisins before serving warm or chilled.

name: Roll Paratha
ingredients: Flour/Besan, Lemon, Oil for frying, Spices
steps: 1. In a large bowl, mix the base ingredients with spices like cumin and chili. 2. Add water slowly to achieve a thick, smooth consistency. 3. Dip the prepared fillings into the batter, ensuring even coating. 4. Heat oil in a deep pan and carefully drop the pieces. 5. Fry on medium heat until golden brown and crispy. 6. Drain excess oil and serve with Roll Paratha specific chutneys.

steps: 1. Bring milk or water to a rolling boil in a heavy-bottomed pot. 2. Add sugar and stir continuously until fully dissolved. 3. Incorporate the primary flavorings like cardamom or saffron. 4. Lower the heat and simmer until the mixture thickens to the desired consistency. 5. Garnish with chopped nuts and raisins before serving warm or chilled.

name: Plain Boiled Rice
ingredients: 500g Basmati Rice, Vegetables, Whole spices, Ghee
steps: 1. Wash the rice multiple times until the water runs clear, then soak for 30 minutes. 2. Sauté whole spices and onions in a pot until golden. 3. Add the meat or vegetables with spices and cook until tender. 4. In a separate pot, boil water with salt and cook rice until 70% done. 5. Layer the rice over the base, add saffron or food color. 6. Seal the pot and simmer (Dum) on low heat for 15-20 minutes to allow flavors to meld.

name: Lacha Paratha
ingredients: 500g Wheat/All-purpose flour, 1 cup Water, 2 tbsp Oil, Salt
steps: 1. Sieve the flour and add salt and water gradually. 2. Knead into a soft, elastic dough and apply a thin layer of oil. 3. Cover with a damp cloth and rest for 30-45 minutes. 4. Divide into equal balls, roll into circles with a rolling pin. 5. Cook on a preheated tawa or in a tandoor until bubbles appear, then flip and apply  2 tbsp Oil.

steps: 1. Sieve the flour and add salt and water gradually. 2. Knead into a soft, elastic dough and apply a thin layer of oil. 3. Cover with a damp cloth and rest for 30-45 minutes. 4. Divide into equal balls, roll into circles with a rolling pin. 5. Cook on a preheated tawa or in a tandoor until bubbles appear, then flip and apply  2 tbsp Oil.

name: Bun Kebab
ingredients: Flour/Besan, Green Chili, Oil for frying, Spices
steps: 1. In a large bowl, mix the base ingredients with spices like cumin and chili. 2. Add water slowly to achieve a thick, smooth consistency. 3. Dip the prepared fillings into the batter, ensuring even coating. 4. Heat oil in a deep pan and carefully drop the pieces. 5. Fry on medium heat until golden brown and crispy. 6. Drain excess oil and serve with Bun Kebab specific chutneys.

name: Mutton Jalfrezi
ingredients: 1kg Mutton, 2 Lemon, 1 tbsp Black pepper, Oil, Salt
steps: 1. Sear meat with ginger-garlic. 2. Add spices and tomatoes. 3. Slow cook until tender. 4. Garnish and serve.

name: Beef Karahi
ingredients: 1kg Beef, 2 Green Chili, 1 tbsp Coriander powder, Oil, Salt
steps: 1. Sear meat with ginger-garlic. 2. Add spices and tomatoes. 3. Slow cook until tender. 4. Garnish and serve.

name: Chana Pulao
ingredients: 500g Basmati Rice, Sugar, Whole spices, Ghee
steps: 1. Wash the rice multiple times until the water runs clear, then soak for 30 minutes. 2. Sauté whole spices and onions in a pot until golden. 3. Add the meat or vegetables with spices and cook until tender. 4. In a separate pot, boil water with salt and cook rice until 70% done. 5. Layer the rice over the base, add saffron or food color. 6. Seal the pot and simmer (Dum) on low heat for 15-20 minutes to allow flavors to meld.

name: Matar Pulao
ingredients: 500g Basmati Rice, Meat, Whole spices, Ghee
steps: 1. Wash the rice multiple times until the water runs clear, then soak for 30 minutes. 2. Sauté whole spices and onions in a pot until golden. 3. Add the meat or vegetables with spices and cook until tender. 4. In a separate pot, boil water with salt and cook rice until 70% done. 5. Layer the rice over the base, add saffron or food color. 6. Seal the pot and simmer (Dum) on low heat for 15-20 minutes to allow flavors to meld.

name: Garlic Naan
ingredients: 500g Wheat/All-purpose flour, 1 cup Water, 2 tbsp Butter, Salt
steps: 1. Sieve the flour and add salt and water gradually. 2. Knead into a soft, elastic dough and apply a thin layer of oil. 3. Cover with a damp cloth and rest for 30-45 minutes. 4. Divide into equal balls, roll into circles with a rolling pin. 5. Cook on a preheated tawa or in a tandoor until bubbles appear, then flip and apply  2 tbsp Butter.

name: French Fries (Masala)
ingredients: Flour/Besan, Garlic, Oil for frying, Spices
steps: 1. In a large bowl, mix the base ingredients with spices like cumin and chili. 2. Add water slowly to achieve a thick, smooth consistency. 3. Dip the prepared fillings into the batter, ensuring even coating. 4. Heat oil in a deep pan and carefully drop the pieces. 5. Fry on medium heat until golden brown and crispy. 6. Drain excess oil and serve with French Fries (Masala) specific chutneys.

name: Chicken Biryani
ingredients: 500g Basmati Rice, Meat, Whole spices, Ghee
steps: 1. Wash the rice multiple times until the water runs clear, then soak for 30 minutes. 2. Sauté whole spices and onions in a pot until golden. 3. Seal the pot and simmer (Dum) on low heat for 15-20 minutes to allow flavors to meld.

name: Roll Paratha

name: Plain Paratha
ingredients: 500g Wheat/All-purpose flour, 1 cup Water, 2 tbsp Ghee, Salt
steps: 1. Sieve the flour and add salt and water gradually. 2. Knead into a soft, elastic dough and apply a thin layer of oil. 3. Cover with a damp cloth and rest for 30-45 minutes. 4. Divide into equal balls, roll into circles with a rolling pin. 5. Cook on a preheated tawa or in a tandoor until bubbles appear, then flip and apply  2 tbsp Ghee.

name: Jalebi
ingredients: 2 cups Ghee, 1 cup Sugar, Cardamom, Saffron, Nuts
steps: 1. Bring milk or water to a rolling boil in a heavy-bottomed pot. 2. Add sugar and stir continuously until fully dissolved. 3. Incorporate the primary flavorings like cardamom or saffron. 4. Lower the heat and simmer until the mixture thickens to the desired consistency. 5. Garnish with chopped nuts and raisins before serving warm or chilled.

steps: 1. Sieve the flour and add salt and water gradually. 2. Knead into a soft, elastic dough and apply a thin layer of oil. 3. Cover with a damp cloth and rest for 30-45 minutes. 4. Divide into equal balls, roll into circles with a rolling pin. 5. Cook on a preheated tawa or in a tandoor until bubbles appear, then flip and apply  2 tbsp Oil.

name: Roll Paratha
ingredients: Flour/Besan, Lemon, Oil for frying, Spices
steps: 1. In a large bowl, mix the base ingredients with spices like cumin and chili. 2. Add water slowly to achieve a thick, smooth consistency. 3. Dip the prepared fillings into the batter, ensuring even coating. 4. Heat oil in a deep pan and carefully drop the pieces. 5. Fry on medium heat until golden brown and crispy. 6. Drain excess oil and serve with Roll Paratha specific chutneys.

name: Fish Sajji
ingredients: 1kg Fish, 2 Tomato, 1 tbsp Coriander powder, Oil, Salt
steps: 1. Sear meat with ginger-garlic. 2. Add spices and tomatoes. 3. Slow cook until tender. 4. Garnish and serve.

name: Zarda
ingredients: 2 cups Milk, 1 cup Sugar, Cardamom, Saffron, Nuts
steps: 1. Bring milk or water to a rolling boil in a heavy-bottomed pot. 2. Add sugar and stir continuously until fully dissolved. 3. Incorporate the primary flavorings like cardamom or saffron. 4. Lower the heat and simmer until the mixture thickens to the desired consistency. 5. Garnish with chopped nuts and raisins before serving warm or chilled.

steps: 1. Wash the rice multiple times until the water runs clear, then soak for 30 minutes. 2. Sauté whole spices and onions in a pot until golden. 3. Add the meat or vegetables with spices and cook until tender. 4. In a separate pot, boil water with salt and cook rice until 70% done. 5. Layer the rice over the base, add saffron or food color. 6. Seal the pot and simmer (Dum) on low heat for 15-20 minutes to allow flavors to meld.

steps: 1. Mix base ingredients. 2. Boil if hot drink or blend with ice if cold. 3. Adjust sweetness and serve.

name: Egg Fried Rice
ingredients: 500g Basmati Rice, Meat, Whole spices, Ghee
steps: 1. Wash the rice multiple times until the water runs clear, then soak for 30 minutes. 2. Sauté whole spices and onions in a pot until golden. 3. Add the meat or vegetables with spices and cook until tender. 4. In a separate pot, boil water with salt and cook rice until 70% done. 5. Layer the rice over the base, add saffron or food color. 6. Seal the pot and simmer (Dum) on low heat for 15-20 minutes to allow flavors to meld.

name: Plain Paratha
ingredients: 500g Wheat/All-purpose flour, 1 cup Water, 2 tbsp Oil, Salt
steps: 1. Sieve the flour and add salt and water gradually. 2. Knead into a soft, elastic dough and apply a thin layer of oil. 3. Cover with a damp cloth and rest for 30-45 minutes. 4. Divide into equal balls, roll into circles with a rolling pin. 5. Cook on a preheated tawa or in a tandoor until bubbles appear, then flip and apply  2 tbsp Oil.

name: Chaat
ingredients: Flour/Besan, Onion, Oil for frying, Spices
steps: 1. In a large bowl, mix the base ingredients with spices like cumin and chili. 2. Add water slowly to achieve a thick, smooth consistency. 3. Dip the prepared fillings into the batter, ensuring even coating. 4. Heat oil in a deep pan and carefully drop the pieces. 5. Fry on medium heat until golden brown and crispy. 6. Drain excess oil and serve with Chaat specific chutneys.

name: Gulab Jamun

steps: 1. Bring milk or water to a rolling boil in a heavy-bottomed pot. 2. Add sugar and stir continuously until fully dissolved. 3. Incorporate the primary flavorings like cardamom or saffron. 4. steps: 1. Sieve the flour and add salt and water gradually. 2. Knead into a soft, elastic dough and apply a thin layer of oil. 3. Cover with a damp cloth and rest for 30-45 minutes. 4. Divide into equal balls, roll into circles with a rolling pin. 5. Cook on a preheated tawa or in a tandoor until bubbles appear, then flip and apply  2 tbsp Ghee.

name: Zarda Rice
ingredients: 500g Basmati Rice, Vegetables, Whole spices, Ghee
steps: 1. Wash the rice multiple times until the water runs clear, then soak for 30 minutes. 2. Sauté whole spices and onions in a pot until golden. 3. Add the meat or vegetables with spices and cook until tender. 4. In a separate pot, boil water with salt and cook rice until 70% done. 5. Layer the rice over the base, add saffron or food color. 6. Seal the pot and simmer (Dum) on low heat for 15-20 minutes to allow flavors to meld.

name: Fish Jalfrezi
ingredients: 1kg Fish, 2 Potato, 1 tbsp Turmeric, Oil, Salt
steps: 1. Sear meat with ginger-garlic. 2. Add spices and tomatoes. 3. Slow cook until tender. 4. Garnish and serve.

name: Masala Chai
ingredients: Water/Milk, Tea leaves, Ice/Heat, Saffron
steps: 1. Mix base ingredients. 2. Boil if hot drink or blend with ice if cold. 3. Adjust sweetness and serve.

name: French Fries (Masala)

steps: 1. Sieve the flour and add salt and water gradually. 2. Knead into a soft, elastic dough and apply a thin layer of oil. 3. Cover with a damp cloth and rest for 30-45 minutes. 4. Divide into equal balls, roll into circles with a rolling pin. 5. Cook on a preheated tawa or in a tandoor until bubbles appear, then flip and apply  2 tbsp Butter.

name: Jalebi
ingredients: 2 cups Butter, 1 cup Sugar, Cardamom, Saffron, Nuts
steps: 1. Bring milk or water to a rolling boil in a heavy-bottomed pot. 2. Add sugar and stir continuously until fully dissolved. 3. Incorporate the primary flavorings like cardamom or saffron. 4. Lower the heat and simmer until the mixture thickens to the desired consistency. 5. Garnish with chopped nuts and raisins before serving warm or chilled.

name: Kabuli Pulao
ingredients: 500g Basmati Rice, Vegetables, Whole spices, Ghee
steps: 1. Wash the rice multiple times until the water runs clear, then soak for 30 minutes. 2. Sauté whole spices and onions in a pot until golden. 3. Add the meat or vegetables with spices and cook until tender. 4. In a separate pot, boil water with salt and cook rice until 70% done. 5. Layer the rice over the base, add saffron or food color. 6. Seal the pot and simmer (Dum) on low heat for 15-20 minutes to allow flavors to meld.

steps: 1. Wash the rice multiple times until the water runs clear, then soak for 30 minutes. 2. Sauté whole spices and onions in a pot until golden. 3. Add the meat or vegetables with spices and cook until tender. 4. In a separate pot, boil water with salt and cook rice until 70% done. 5. Layer the rice over the base, add saffron or food color. 6. Seal the pot and simmer (Dum) on low heat for 15-20 minutes to allow flavors to meld.

name: Beef Haleem
ingredients: 1kg Beef, 2 Coriander Leaves, 1 tbsp Coriander powder, Oil, Salt
steps: 1. Sear meat with ginger-garlic. 2. Add spices and tomatoes. 3. Slow cook until tender. 4. Garnish and serve.

name: Gol Gappay
ingredients: Flour/Besan, Onion, Oil for frying, Spices
steps: 1. In a large bowl, mix the base ingredients with spices like cumin and chili. 2. Add water slowly to achieve a thick, smooth consistency. 3. Dip the prepared fillings into the batter, ensuring even coating. 4. Heat oil in a deep pan and carefully drop the pieces. 5. Fry on medium heat until golden brown and crispy. 6. Drain excess oil and serve with Gol Gappay specific chutneys.

name: Beef Saag
ingredients: 1kg Beef, 2 Spinach, 1 tbsp Coriander powder, Oil, Salt
steps: 1. Sear meat with ginger-garlic. 2. Add spices and tomatoes. 3. Slow cook until tender. 4. Garnish and serve.

name: Ras Malai
ingredients: 2 cups Ghee, 1 cup Sugar, Cardamom, Saffron, Nuts
steps: 1. Bring milk or water to a rolling boil in a heavy-bottomed pot. 2. Add sugar and stir continuously until fully dissolved. 3. Incorporate the primary flavorings like cardamom or saffron. 4. Lower the heat and simmer until the mixture thickens to the desired consistency. 5. Garnish with chopped nuts and raisins before serving warm or chilled.

steps: 1. Sieve the flour and add salt and water gradually. 2. Knead into a soft, elastic dough and apply a thin layer of oil. 3. Cover with a damp cloth and rest for 30-45 minutes. 4. Divide into equal balls, roll into circles with a rolling pin. 5. Cook on a preheated tawa or in a tandoor until bubbles appear, then flip and apply  2 tbsp Oil.

name: Samosa
ingredients: Flour/Besan, Potato, Oil for frying, Spices
steps: 1. In a large bowl, mix the base ingredients with spices like cumin and chili. 2. Add water slowly to achieve a thick, smooth consistency. 3. Dip the prepared fillings into the batter, ensuring even coating. 4. Heat oil in a deep pan and carefully drop the pieces. 5. Fry on medium heat until golden brown and crispy. 6. Drain excess oil and serve with Samosa specific chutneys.

name: Kabuli Pulao
ingredients: 500g Basmati Rice, Meat, Whole spices, Ghee

steps: 1. Sieve the flour and add salt and water gradually. 2. Knead into a soft, elastic dough and apply a thin layer of oil. 3. Cover with a damp cloth and rest for 30-45 minutes. 4. Divide into equal balls, roll into circles with a rolling pin. 5. Cook on a preheated tawa or in a tandoor until bubbles appear, then flip and apply  2 tbsp Butter.

name: Zarda
ingredients: 2 cups Paneer, 1 cup Sugar, Cardamom, Saffron, Nuts

name: Zarda Rice
ingredients: 500g Basmati Rice, Sugar, Whole spices, Ghee
steps: 1. Wash the rice multiple times until the water runs clear, then soak for 30 minutes. 2. Sauté whole spices and onions in a pot until golden. 3. Add the meat or vegetables with spices and cook until tender. 4. In a separate pot, boil water with salt and cook rice until 70% done. 5. Layer the rice over the base, add saffron or food color. 6. Seal the pot and simmer (Dum) on low heat for 15-20 minutes to allow flavors to meld.

steps: 1. Sieve the flour and add salt and water gradually. 2. Knead into a soft, elastic dough and apply a thin layer of oil. 3. Cover with a damp cloth and rest for 30-45 minutes. 4. Divide into equal balls, roll into circles with a rolling pin. 5. Cook on a preheated tawa or in a tandoor until bubbles appear, then flip and apply  2 tbsp Ghee.

name: Phirni
ingredients: 2 cups Butter, 1 cup Sugar, Cardamom, Saffron, Nuts
steps: 1. Bring milk or water to a rolling boil in a heavy-bottomed pot. 2. Add sugar and stir continuously until fully dissolved. 3. Incorporate the primary flavorings like cardamom or saffron. 4. Lower the heat and simmer until the mixture thickens to the desired consistency. 5. Garnish with chopped nuts and raisins before serving warm or chilled.

name: Yakhni Pulao
ingredients: 500g Basmati Rice, Vegetables, Whole spices, Ghee
steps: 1. Wash the rice multiple times until the water runs clear, then soak for 30 minutes. 2. Sauté whole spices and onions in a pot until golden. 3. steps: 1. Mix base ingredients. 2. Boil if hot drink or blend with ice if cold. 3. Adjust sweetness and serve.

name: Kheer
ingredients: 2 cups Cream, 1 cup Sugar, Cardamom, Saffron, Nuts
steps: 1. Bring milk or water to a rolling boil in a heavy-bottomed pot. 2. Add sugar and stir continuously until fully dissolved. 3. Incorporate the primary flavorings like cardamom or saffron. 4. Lower the heat and simmer until the mixture thickens to the desired consistency. 5. Garnish with chopped nuts and raisins before serving warm or chilled.

name: Garlic Naan
ingredients: 500g Wheat/All-purpose flour, 1 cup Water, 2 tbsp Ghee, Salt
steps: 1. Sieve the flour and add salt and water gradually. 2. Knead into a soft, elastic dough and apply a thin layer of oil. 3. Cover with a damp cloth and rest for 30-45 minutes. 4. Divide into equal balls, roll into circles with a rolling pin. 5. Cook on a preheated tawa or in a tandoor until bubbles appear, then flip and apply  2 tbsp Ghee.

name: Gol Gappay
ingredients: Flour/Besan, Onion, Oil for frying, Spices

steps: 1. Wash the rice multiple times until the water runs clear, then soak for 30 minutes. 2. Sauté whole spices and onions in a pot until golden. 3. Add the meat or vegetables with spices and cook until tender. 4. In a separate pot, boil water with salt and cook rice until 70% done. 5. Layer the rice over the base, add saffron or food color. 6. Seal the pot and simmer (Dum) on low heat for 15-20 minutes to allow flavors to meld.

steps: 1. In a large bowl, mix the base ingredients with spices like cumin and chili. 2. Add water slowly to achieve a thick, smooth consistency. 3. Dip the prepared fillings into the batter, ensuring even coating. 4. Heat oil in a deep pan and carefully drop the pieces. 5. Fry on medium heat until golden brown and crispy. 6. Drain excess oil and serve with Dahi Bhallay specific chutneys.

name: Kulfi
ingredients: 2 cups Ghee, 1 cup Sugar, Cardamom, Saffron, Nuts
steps: 1. Bring milk or water to a rolling boil in a heavy-bottomed pot. 2. Add sugar and stir continuously until fully dissolved. 3. Incorporate the primary flavorings like cardamom or saffron. 4. name: Chana Pulao
ingredients: 500g Basmati Rice, Sugar, Whole spices, Ghee
steps: 1. Wash the rice multiple times until the water runs clear, then soak for 30 minutes. 2. Sauté whole spices and onions in a pot until golden. 3. Add the meat or vegetables with spices and cook until tender. 4. In a separate pot, boil water with salt and cook rice until 70% done. 5. Layer the rice over the base, add saffron or food color. 6. Seal the pot and simmer (Dum) on low heat for 15-20 minutes to allow flavors to meld.

steps: 1. Sear meat with ginger-garlic. 2. Add spices and tomatoes. 3. Slow cook until tender. 4. Garnish and serve.

name: Zarda Rice
ingredients: 500g Basmati Rice, Vegetables, Whole spices, Ghee
steps: 1. Wash the rice multiple times until the water runs clear, then soak for 30 minutes. 2. Sauté whole spices and onions in a pot until golden. 3. Add the meat or vegetables with spices and cook until tender. 4. In a separate pot, boil water with salt and cook rice until 70% done. 5. Layer the rice over the base, add saffron or food color. 6. Seal the pot and simmer (Dum) on low heat for 15-20 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
